name: Sacrifice
overview: Scripture reveals that true sacrifice transcends mere ritual offerings, emphasizing a heart of brokenness and justice over external acts (Psalms 51:17; Proverbs 21:3). Jesus taught that mercy is preferred above sacrifice, highlighting God's desire for repentance rather than ritual compliance (Matthew 9:13). The ultimate example of sacrifice is found in Christ's giving of Himself for the world, demonstrating the greatest love by laying down His life (John 3:16; John 15:13). Believers are called to respond by offering themselves as living sacrifices, yielding their lives and actions to God in righteousness (Romans 6:13).
